solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/check-if-every-row-and-column-contains-all-numbers/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2133. Check if Every Row and Column Contains All Numbers

An n x n matrix is valid if every row and every column contains all the integers from 1 to n (inclusive).

Given an n x n integer matrix matrix, return true if the matrix is valid. Otherwise, return false.

Example 1:

Input: matrix = [[1,2,3],[3,1,2],[2,3,1]]
Output: true
Explanation: In this case, n = 3, and every row and column contains the numbers 1, 2, and 3.
Hence, we return true.

Example 2:

Input: matrix = [[1,1,1],[1,2,3],[1,2,3]]
Output: false
Explanation: In this case, n = 3, but the first row and the first column do not contain the numbers 2 or 3.
Hence, we return false.

Constraints:

    n == matrix.length == matrix[i].length
    1 <= n <= 100
    1 <= matrix[i][j] <= n
"""


class Solution:
    def checkValid(self, matrix: List[List[int]]) -> bool:
        n = len(matrix)
        required = set(range(1, n + 1))
        for i in range(n):
            row_set = set(matrix[i])
            if row_set != required:
                return False
            col_set = set(matrix[j][i] for j in range(n))
            if col_set != required:
                return False
        return True


sol = Solution()

print(sol.checkValid([[1, 2, 3], [3, 1, 2], [2, 3, 1]]))  # True

assert sol.checkValid([[1, 2, 3], [3, 1, 2], [2, 3, 1]]) == True
assert sol.checkValid([[1, 1, 1], [1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3]]) == False

assert sol.checkValid([[1]]) == True
assert sol.checkValid([[1, 2], [2, 1]]) == True
assert sol.checkValid([[2, 1], [1, 2]]) == True
assert sol.checkValid([[1, 1], [1, 1]]) == False
assert sol.checkValid([[1, 2, 3, 4], [2, 3, 4, 1], [3, 4, 1, 2], [4, 1, 2, 3]]) == True
assert sol.checkValid([[1, 2, 3, 4], [2, 3, 4, 1], [3, 4, 1, 2], [4, 1, 2, 2]]) == False
assert sol.checkValid([[100] * 100 for _ in range(100)]) == False
assert sol.checkValid([list(range(1, 101)) for _ in range(100)]) == False
assert (
    sol.checkValid([list(range(1, 101))] + [list(range(2, 102)) for _ in range(99)])
    == False
)
assert (
    sol.checkValid([[i if i != 50 else 1 for i in range(1, 101)] for _ in range(100)])
    == False
)
assert sol.checkValid([[i for i in range(1, 101)] for _ in range(100)]) == False
assert (
    sol.checkValid([[i if j != i else 1 for j in range(1, 101)] for i in range(1, 101)])
    == False
)
